But the cats will capture those who fall in some specific traps. Will you be able to score some points avoiding them? Or, even better, will you face them all for even more of points? Players play trick-taking hands, following usual trick-taking rules (must follow, trump, etc). In each round, though, some cats (missions) should be avoided. For example, the player should not have the most 8s. Or one specific card, the red 7. Or maybe can not win trick number 4. Points are awarded according to tricks won and cats avoided. After a certain number of rounds, the player with the most points is the winner. Number of players: 2 - 5 Game duration: 10 mn Complexity: 2 / 5 Play Cheez-Tricks and 1414 other games online. Discover Board Game Arena Rules summary Cheez-Tricks is a trick-taking game where you should avoid some missions (or try to get them all for more points). Deck composition: 2 players: 1-7 3 players: 1-9 4 and 5 players: 1-10 All the cards are dealt, except in 2 players where 20 cards are dealt and 8 are removed from the game. Playing the game: Regular rules for trick-taking game: must follow suit, trump (random on the first round, chose by the player who has the least score on all the others). Highest card of the trump takes the trick; in case of no trumps, highest card of the lead suit takes the trick. Scoring: Number of tricks x 2 if you have not been captured by any cat. Number of tricks x 1 if you have been captured by 1 cat. Zero points if you have been captured by 2 cats. Number of tricks x 3 if you have been captured by all cats. BGA deck by color / cheese: Orange = Parmesan Red = Swiss Green = Roquefort Blue = Brie After rounds = number of players, the player who has the most points is the winner. The Cats: Black Cat: Capture the player who wins a certain trick. Siamese Cat: Capture the player who wins a certain card. White Cat: Capture the first player who wins a certain amount of tricks Gray Cat: Capture the player that wins the most of a card/suit/tricks by the end of the round. Orange Cat: Capture the player that wins the least of a card/suit/tricks by the end of the round. Tuxedo Cat: Capture the player that wins exactly a certain amount of tricks by the end of the round. [Rating: 5.5/10] Trick-taking game with certain triggers each hand. 3 cats will be given out when the event happens for example, the blue 6 is won and the winner takes the cat. You don't want any cats, or you want all the cats. With 5 players the game felt long. Perhaps with 3, it will be better. Fairly basic trick-taking but it was cute.

[Rating: 6/10] Torselli bga. The hook is that each round has three randomly chosen special "lose" conditions-- e.g. don't catch 3rd trick, or don't catch 3 of blue cheese suit, or don't take 4 tricks in total etc. Each time you fulfill those you earn that Cat. You score your tricks won, but avoid special condition ("cats")-- unless you can catch all three.  Scoring very elegant: no cats you score 2x your tricks; 1 cat your score 1x your tricks; 3 cats you score 4x your tricks. That last bit is the tension that drives the game, and it's coolest feature.
